TEST-094 establishes explicit pinned versus ordinary selection; TEST-095/096 establish transport and agent non-interference, not precedence among conflicting explicit sources. Implementers and verifiers therefore lack an expected result when CLI, environment and configuration specify different valid models or policies. This is a Phase-1 observable behavior gap, not an architecture or command requirement; Major because divergent host implementations could satisfy the existing tests while selecting different models. State the precedence or conflict-rejection rule and add corresponding acceptance branches.
